notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section, Pub. L. 95–195, § 2, Nov. 18, 1977, 91 Stat. 1415, which set out definitions, was omitted from the Code as being of special and not general application.

notes.heading: Short Title
notes.text: Pub. L. 95–195, § 1, Nov. 18, 1977, 91 Stat. 1415, provided that Pub. L. 95–195, enacting this subchapter, could be cited as the “Siletz Indian Tribe Restoration Act”.

ancestors.heading: SILETZ INDIAN TRIBE: RESTORATION OF FEDERAL SUPERVISION
